**Long headers take extra work** The new loop rebuilds and lowercases every shorter prefix of an unchecked `Accept-Language` tag. A header with thousands of short, hyphen-separated subtags now takes quadratic string work instead of the previous two lookups. Servers using `preferredLanguage` repeat that extra work on every such request. Consider comparing the input against configured locale prefixes instead of rebuilding every shorter string.
